info.name: Vyaguta API Tests
info.description: API test suite for the Vyaguta API at {{baseUrl}}. Requests are grouped into one folder per resource, plus a 'Behavior & Edge Cases' folder documenting known quirks. Authenticated with a Bearer token from {{authToken}}.

exec: // TOKEN AUTOMATION — fill in once the login endpoint is confirmed.
// If Vyaguta uses a login endpoint (not a static/SSO token), uncomment and
// complete the block below. It fetches a fresh token before each request and
// stores it in authToken so the collection-level Bearer auth picks it up.
// Set LOGIN_URL and the request body fields to match the actual endpoint.

item.name: Sanity
item.description: One representative request per module. Asserts status 200, Content-Type, and non-empty body only. Run on every PR/push for fast feedback.

item.name: Health
item.description: Lightweight GET per critical endpoint. Runs every 2 hours via health-check.yml to confirm the API is reachable.

item.name: People
item.description: Tests for the People module (employees, profiles, org structure).

item.name: Team
item.description: Tests for the Team module (team listings, members, hierarchy).

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Tests for the Attendance module (check-in/out, attendance records, reports).

item.name: Honor
item.description: Tests for the Honor module (recognitions, awards).

item.name: OKR
item.description: Tests for the OKR module (objectives, key results, check-ins).

item.name: Pulse
item.description: Tests for the Pulse module (surveys, feedback).

item.name: Behavior & Edge Cases
item.description: Auth negative tests and known API quirks. Auth role coverage to be expanded once user roles are confirmed.
